days.intro: Walkers and sitters are booking like mad. Every booking gets a care kit. Let's fetch!
Zoomies orders are for walks starting in an hour. Half of bookings get abandoned when we are slow.
Bowls and shampoo bottles hate the post. Bubble wrap first, or it is a soggy doormat.
The app crashed during booking again and the belt stopped with it. Pull the lever. Kennels in stock!
Holiday rush. Every dog in town needs a sitter and every sitter needs a kit. Good luck!
